payload.summary: Both amendments identify real, verified bugs. Amendment fr-2-5f3aaec6: the ALL array now has TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings at index 3, shifting AddShrimp to index 6, so 5 advances lands on CleanFilter (which accepts floats), making the integer-rejection test silently pass or test the wrong action. Amendment fr-2-d613a3c7: git history confirms old TrimPlants routed trimmed biomass to fine_detritus (kept in tank), identical to TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings; the migration incorrectly maps it to TrimPlantsAndRemove which exports biomass out of the system, silently changing gameplay for migrated saves.

votes.rationale: Verified: ActionKind::ALL now has 13 entries with TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings inserted at index 3. Five calls to select_next_action() lands on CleanFilter (index 5), not AddShrimp (index 6). CleanFilter accepts a float intensity field, so "1.5" parses successfully and submit() returns Ok instead of Err, meaning the test either panics on expect_err or (worse) silently tests the wrong thing. The fix — either incrementing the loop count to 6 or navigating by ActionKind match — is straightforward and correct.

Git history definitively confirms the original TrimPlants added trimmed biomass to fine_detritus_g_total (kept biomass in-tank), which is semantically identical to the new TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings variant. The migration maps TrimPlants → TrimPlantsAndRemove, which exports biomass out of the system entirely — the opposite of the original behavior. This is a real save-compatibility bug that silently changes gameplay for any migrated save with queued trim actions. The correct mapping should be TrimPlants → TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings, or at minimum the intentional semantic change must be documented.
